name: La Reserve Geneve Hotel, Spa & Villa
positioning: Low-slung lakeside hotel (officially La Reserve Geneve - Hotel and Spa) in a 10-acre park on Lake Geneva, five kilometers from downtown, with the Spa Nescens and the Cantonese restaurant Tse Fung
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-focused stay combining treatments, nutrition and fitness
Families wanting pools, a Kid's Club and a wooden playground near Geneva
Guests who want a lakeside park setting with a boat ride into the city

facts.text: The hotel sits in a landscaped park of 10 acres on the shores of Lake Geneva.
The hotel is five kilometers from downtown Geneva.
The hotel is 2 miles from the nearest international airport.
The hotel's restaurant Tse Fung serves Cantonese cuisine.
Cafe Lauren is set at the heart of the Spa Nescens.
The hotel has outdoor and indoor swimming pools, a Kid's Club and sports facilities.
The spa's fitness and relaxation area includes swimming pools, a fitness center, sauna, hammam and tennis courts.
Spa services are provided by a team of therapists, coaches and medical specialists in preventive, anti-aging and aesthetic medicine.
The spa offers a Rossano Ferretti Hair Spa.
The hotel offers a villa, the Villa du Lac.
Children can use an elaborate wooden playground.
The hotel has vintage motorboats for waterborne outings.

highlights.text: Interiors follow an Old-World Africa theme, with gold, walnut and berry shades, glowing lanterns and dark polished floors reminiscent of Africa's luxury lodges.
The Spa Nescens combines treatments, nutrition and physical activity.
Guests can take a motoscafo boat ride between Geneva city center and the hotel.
Rooms look over the gardens or the lake, and most have their own large terrace or balcony.
The Spa Nescens appears in the Vogue Global Spa Guide 2026 and received a Falstaff Spa Guide Award 2026 with 97 points.

considerations.text: Admission to the spa is for guests aged 14 and over, and from June 1 to September 30 the indoor pool is reserved for adults and children aged 14 and over.
Pets are not allowed in the spa, the outdoor pool and the surrounding area.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
